customer_service.title: Customer service

options.transaction_status: Check the status of a payment or transaction.
options.refund_status: Check the status of a refund that was already requested.
options.refund_request: Start a refund for an order or a charge.
options.generate_invoice: Create an invoice or receipt for an order.
options.order_tracking: Track where a shipped order is right now.
options.cancel_order: Cancel an order that has not shipped yet.
options.update_payment_method: Change the card or payment method on file.
options.update_shipping_address: Change the delivery address of an order.
options.dispute_charge: Report a charge that is unrecognized or incorrect.
options.talk_to_agent: Connect the customer with a human support agent.

examples: There's a $49.99 charge on my statement I don't recognize
I asked for my money back last week, has it been processed?
Can I speak to a real person please
I want to cancel my monthly subscription
How do I reset my password?

banking.title: Banking

options.card_arrival: Ask when a card that was ordered will arrive.
options.lost_or_stolen_card: Report a card as lost or stolen.
options.activate_my_card: Ask how to activate a new card.
options.transfer_limit: Ask what the maximum amount for a single transfer is.
options.transfer_fee: Ask why a fee was charged for a transfer.
options.cancel_transfer: Cancel a transfer that was just made.
options.exchange_rate: Look up the exchange rate between two currencies.
options.pin_change: Change the PIN of a card.

examples: what's the most I can send in one transfer?
someone stole my wallet with my card in it
how many euros will I get for 100 dollars?
how do I open a savings account?

smart_assistant.title: Smart assistant

options.reminder: Create a reminder for a task.
options.calendar: Check or add events on a calendar.
options.time: Ask what the current time is.
options.play_music: Play a song, artist or playlist.

examples: remind me to call mom at 5
set an alarm for 6 am tomorrow
turn off the living room lights

travel.title: Travel & dining

options.restaurant_reservation: Book a table at a restaurant.
options.restaurant_reviews: Look up reviews of a restaurant.
options.uber: Book a ride with a car service.
options.car_rental: Rent a car for a trip.

examples: book me a table for two at 8 tonight
find me a hotel room in Paris for 3 nights
get me a ride to the airport
do I need a visa to visit Japan?
